Thank you for attending our “Delivering with Confidence in the COVID-19 Era” webinar!
In our recent blog post <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/delivering-with-confidence-drive-international-student-enrollment-in-south-africa?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>, we highlighted the major takeaways discussed during the webinar and hope you find the quick read helpful.
<[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/delivering-with-confidence-drive-international-student-enrollment-in-south-africa?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
A special shoutout to the panelists of our webinar:
- Mr. Bongarala Sri giri Srinivasa Rao, Managing Director, Ivy Overseas - Mr. Nathaniel Veltkamp, Manager, International Recruitment & Project Development, St. Clair College - Mr. Brandon Clifford, Student Ambassador, Swiss Education Group - Mrs. Judy Goddard, Student Ambassador, Swiss Education Group
Have any questions? Just reply to this email and we’ll connect you with someone who can help. And, if you’d like to see a demo of Flywire's Education Payments <[[https://www.flywire.com/industries/education?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>, just let us know.
